blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Agatha Wong begins her Asian Games 2026 campaign Sunday looking to return to the podium in the women’s taijiquan and taijijian events at Aichi Prefectural Martial Arts Hall. The six-time Southeast Asian Games gold medalist is the Philippines’ top wushu bet but faces a strong field led by defending Asian Games champion Tong Xin of China.
